text:
maria: FYI TideLedger (prod account) hit a big EU traffic spike an hour ago. They asked for a temporary rate lift + allowlist for some proxy subnets. Renewal is in ~7 weeks, so this is a higher-touch onboarding/ops ask — want to avoid churn if the spike causes failures.

sam: Can you drop the CIDRs and desired duration? Is autorevoke acceptable?

maria: CIDRs below. They want the bump for 72h and an autorevoke, then we'll reassess. Also reported a few 429s and some SDK retry confusion.

maria: ```
# TideLedger allowlist
54.192.0.0/18
18.197.0.0/16
185.12.44.0/22
# Requested window: 72h starting now
```

jorge: I'll take onboarding + SDK followup. I saw their support ticket about exponential backoff not kicking in consistently for long-poll flows. If we can bump EU qps from 50 -> 250 for region-scoped policy, that should smooth errors while I push a small client retry patch.

keiko: Region-scoped policies are doable. Recommend a canary: 50 -> 150 for first 30m then 250 if stable. We can set an autorevoke TTL for the allowlist. Need infra sign-off for route policy change.

alex: Renewal note — anniversary ~2026-05-12. Usage spikes could indicate expansion; AE should be notified to offer committed capacity pricing if they stay at this level. I'll tag lisa-AE.

sam: Queued the ipset update, request ID UI-9821. Applying EU-only allowlist now, will propagate to edge in ~5m. Also created a rate-policy PR to allow a 72h override window.

deploy-bot: ingress-rule-applied tideledger-prod-eu ipset ui-9821: [54.192.0.0/18, 18.197.0.0/16, 185.12.44.0/22] (propagate=ok)

maria: Great — Jorge, can you capture SDK errors and add a repro? Also let's capture customer feedback: they said error text is ambiguous and docs for retry are buried.

jorge: Will open GH issue and attach logs from their support dump. GH #1127 created: "tideledger: fix client retry/backoff docs + repro". Also proposing enabling per-route KV cache for their high-prefix workloads; should reduce token usage and costs.

keiko: Autorevoke set for 2026-05-01T18:00:00Z. Canary policy applied: 50->150 now, auto-promote to 250 at +30m if error rate <1%.

alex: Marking renewal risk 'medium' pending outcome. AE notified (lisa-AE). Suggest a product sync tomorrow after onboarding.

maria: Closing loop here: allowlist live, EU QPS bumped per policy (canary->250), autorevoke on 2026-05-01T18:00Z, onboarding scheduled for tomorrow 10:00 UTC, Jorge will share SDK patch + GH issue. I'll follow up on renewal notes after the 72h window. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
